title: Seat Tier H hand-off as one relay write: approval comment + pm:awaiting-merge + pr_request_reviewers, refused without ACCEPT and a same-head PASS
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filed after a seat miss on 2026-11-20. The maintainer asked 「35921 没看到维护者合并的标签」 and 「为什么会漏，如何避免类似的错误」.

## What happened
The seat handed three Tier H PRs (#35582, #35757 and #35921) to the maintainer by posting a "Tier H approval request" comment that @-mentioned the approver. It did not make the other two writes the skill defines for the hand-off (`SKILL.md` 194–207, terminal four-piece ② and ③). It added no `pm:awaiting-merge` label and sent no `pr_request_reviewers` request. So none of the three was in the maintainer's awaiting-merge list or review queue, and they waited about 4.5 hours. The seat fixed it at 22:10Z (request) and 22:18Z (label), and both read back.

The rule text was not missing. Nor were the instruments: `check-half-states.mjs` rows H43 (no approver asked) and H48 (ACCEPT without the label) find exactly this state. The cause is that the hand-off is three separate manual writes, made from a comment template that held only one of them, and that the patrol never ran the reading that would have flagged it.

## To do
1. Add a hand-off mode to `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`, for example `--issue PR --comment-file request.md --handoff`, that does the whole hand-off in ONE relay run:
   - posts the approval-request comment;
   - adds `pm:awaiting-merge`;
   - requests review from every `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account not already requested, assigned or reviewed (the author is assigned instead, as `execute.mjs` does after `pr_ready`);
   - reads all three back.
   It refuses with zero writes when `check-governed-merges` doesn't read Tier H, or when the current head lacks a `## 席位核对` ACCEPT and a same-tier `## Contract review` PASS (the same reading `--land` uses).
2. Point the skill's hand-off line (`SKILL.md` 203) at that one command, so that no seat makes the three writes by hand.
3. Have the seat patrol read H43 and H48 on its own governed PRs every round (`execution-duties.md` 16–17 already asks for it), either as a fast `--rows H43,H48` mode of `check-half-states.mjs` (a full run takes over two minutes) or as a part of `--handoff`'s own read-back.

## Acceptance
- A self-test shows `--handoff` writes all three, refuses on a Tier S PR, refuses with no same-head PASS, and assigns rather than requests an approver who is the author.
- A seat that runs only `--handoff` leaves the PR passing H43 and H48.

Reader: area:fleet (scripts/pm, skills text).
